agglutinative.description: Dem dey build word by dey stack affix one after anoda, and each affix get just one meaning. Di parts still dey clear, like building block wey dem snap join.
agglutinative.label: Agglutinative

fusional.description: Word dey change im form through ending and prefix wey mix plenty grammar meaning togeda for one time. One ending fit show gender, number, and case all at once, so e hard to separate di parts.
fusional.label: Fusional

introflexive.description: Grammar dey enta di word from inside: consonant root dey carry di main meaning, and different vowel pattern wey dey pass through am dey create new word. Like, di Arabik root k-t-b relate to writing, and kataba, kitāb, and kātib all come from am.
introflexive.label: Introflexive

isolating.description: Word dem normally get just one morpheme and dem no dey change form. Grammar dey show through how you arrange word and separate function word, no be ending or prefix.
isolating.label: Isolating

polysynthetic.description: One single word fit talk wetin oda language go need whole sentence to talk, by dey join verb, subject, object, and oda tin togeda. E common for indigenous language dem for America and Arctic.
polysynthetic.label: Polysynthetic

complex-tonal.description: Pitch pattern dey affect word meaning well well.

non-tonal.description: Pitch no dey change word meaning at all.

pitch-accent.description: E dey use pitch accent, where certain syllable dem dey get emphasis with pitch change.

simple-tonal.description: Pitch change dey affect word meaning small small.

rigid.description: Word dem get fixed grammar position wey no dey change.
rigid.label: E no dey change

semi-flexible.description: Small variation for word order dey allowed to put emphasis for something.
